audience: sales teams and account managers who keep their pipeline in SalesNOW

useCases.title: Review recently changed records
useCases.text: List the contacts or companies changed in a time window. Open one record to read all its fields.

useCases.title: Review the deals of a company
useCases.text: Open a company record. Then list the deals and open each one to read its fields.

useCases.title: Work through new leads
useCases.text: List the leads changed in a time window. Open each lead to read its fields.

useCases.title: Check the task list
useCases.text: List the tasks changed in a time window. Open a task to read its fields, such as its title and due date.

useCases.title: Add a follow-up task for a contact
useCases.text: Read the field names of the task record first. Then create a follow-up task with a title and a due date.

useCases.title: Update a contact and mark a task done
useCases.text: Change the given fields of a contact. Set a task to done. Fields you leave out keep their values.
